name: aitrends-3d-studio
description: Turn a script into a finished 3D animated story video: channel identity kit, script check, emotional open-source voiceover (Chatterbox, Kokoro fallback), word timings, story breakdown, code-built 3D sets (city, school, home, beach, island, snow, farm, underwater, space) and stick characters (Three.js), light from props, game HUD, first-person shots, animated explainer diagrams, style and palette choice, frame-by-frame render up to 4K / 60 fps, generated music and SFX, quality scorecard, final MP4.
